decisions.reason: Because the firm is growing and has slack to tolerate uncertain adjacent initiatives, management would likely keep this ecosystem-building program for now, though its weaker fit with the core machinery business makes it the most disposable if search shifts back to core uses of resources.

As a flagship tied to the firm's R&D identity and strategic direction, this product is likely to be retained while management continues learning from the market, even if commercialization may be slower than for core equipment.

This decontamination plant is close to the established modular recycling offer and was highlighted as a focus product, so in a growing firm it is likely to stay unless results clearly fall below aspirations.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's core technical capabilities and customer base well, so management is more likely to continue commercialization than to redeploy its resources elsewhere.
